summary: Loma Negra Compania Industrial Argentina filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited consolidated condensed interim financial statements as of March 31, 2026, along with an English translation of its Argentine regulatory filing. The filing reports net revenues of approximately $218.7 million and net profit of $40.6 million for the period, with basic earnings per share of 70.27 Argentine pesos. There is no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation; the document is a routine periodic financial disclosure. The filing does not involve any transaction, recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics typical of special situations.
